_comment: Example pipeline for pipeline_runner.py. Copy to pipeline.json (gitignored) and delete the steps for platforms you do not use: a standalone script without credentials fails rather than skipping, unlike run_sync.py. Script paths are relative to the repo root. See docs/health.md.

daily.description: Nightly refresh: independent API pulls, then a backup, then the health check and change-only alert.

waves.description: Independent pulls. None reads another's output, so they overlap; SQLite still serialises their writes behind db.BUSY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

steps.description: The six shared-table connectors; skips any without credentials.
Current-state snapshot with no backfill: a missed day is lost for good.

waves.description: Back up only after every writer above has finished.
Strictly last: both read everything. warehouse_health exits 1 on any ERROR; health_alerts is what reaches a person, and only when something changed.

weekly.description: Slower, heavier pulls that do not need a daily cadence.
